title: An immersion representing a single direct-image rank condition
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be flat, proper and locally of finite presentation. Assume the structure-sheaf adjunction unit $\mathcal O_T\to p_*p^*\mathcal O_T$ is an isomorphism for every base change $g:T\to S$ [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Let E and F be finite locally free modules on X. There exist a scheme W and an immersion j:W\to S such that, for every test g:T\to S, g factors through j if and only if R_1(f,E,F,g) holds [def-sc-picard-universal-single-rank-match]. The conclusion concerns only F, not an additional direct image of its dual.

proof.text: The universal structure-sheaf unit gives H^0(X_s,O)=kappa(s). Hence X_s is nonempty, and any decomposition into two nonempty clopen pieces would yield a nontrivial idempotent, so X_s is connected. The rank of E is locally constant and thus constant on each fibre. Flat local finite presentation makes f open and properness makes it closed. Its clopen rank loci have disjoint clopen images S_r covering S. E has rank r on the inverse image of S_r; the clopen rank-locus argument is [lem-sc-picard-fiber-rank-clopen].

On each S_r the finite locally free F is finitely presented and flat over the base. Apply [lem-pc-rf-perfect-base-change] to obtain perfect Rf_*F with arbitrary derived base change. H^0 of each derived pullback is the ordinary direct image p_*q^*F. All derived fibres have no negative cohomology; a finite strictly perfect model locally has Tor-amplitude [0,b] for some b.

Apply [lem-sc-perfect-h0-locally-closed] with a=0 and the fixed rank r. It supplies an immersion characterized by universal rank-r freeness of the one ordinary direct image. In R_1 any local witness rank equals r, since E has rank r on the whole inverse image and every fibre is nonempty. Restriction preserves rank, and fixed-rank finite local freeness is local on the test scheme. Thus its condition is equivalent to this universal rank-r condition.

On overlapping neighbourhoods the immersions represent the same functor. Since immersions are monomorphisms, their unique identifications agree on triple overlaps and glue. The clopen strata are disjoint, so their union also glues to an immersion over S. Test morphisms factor precisely when R_1 holds: its witnesses give local factors and uniqueness glues them. On the empty test scheme both criteria hold without points; r=0 uses the same construction.

lean.statement: theorem exists_picardUniversalSingleRankLocus {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] (hO : ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ S), IsIso ((Classical.choose (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f g))).unit.app (SheafOfModules.unit T.ringCatSheaf))) (E F : X.Modules) [E.IsFiniteLocallyFree] [F.IsFiniteLocallyFree] : ∃ (W : Scheme.{u}) (j : W ⟶ S), IsImmersion j ∧ ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ S), (∃ h : T ⟶ W, h ≫ j = g) ↔ PicardUniversalSingleRankMatch f E F g
